  "metadata": {
    "send_date": "1932-09-07",
    "letter_title": "Petition for Environmental Protection",
    "sender_persons": ["Lisa Simpson"],
    "receiver_persons": ["Mayor Joe Quimby", "Seymour Skinner"]
  },
  "content": "Dear Mayor Quimby and Mr. Skinner,

We, the undersigned, hereby submit a petition to you, the City Council of Springfield, to take immediate action to protect our environment from the harmful effects of pollution and deforestation. We believe that it is your responsibility to ensure that our city remains a clean and healthy place to live for future generations.

We urge you to implement stricter regulations on industrial waste disposal and to promote sustainable practices in our community. We also request that you allocate more resources to environmental education and awareness programs.

Thank you for your attention to this matter. We look forward to your prompt response.

Sincerely,
Lisa Simpson"
}

Dear Mayor Quimby and Mr. Skinner,

We, the undersigned, hereby submit a petition to you, the City Council of Springfield, to take immediate action to protect our environment from the harmful effects of pollution and deforestation. We believe that it is your responsibility to ensure that our city remains a clean and healthy place to live for future generations.

We urge you to implement stricter regulations on industrial waste disposal and to promote sustainable practices in our community. We also request that you allocate more resources to environmental education and awareness programs.

Thank you for your attention to this matter. We look forward to your prompt response.

Sincerely,
Lisa Simpson
